scope: Bounded offline self-hosted English rendering pilot after the revised bilingual product decisions. No feature implementation or production deployment.
decision: No accepted pipeline; keep revised specs and conduct source-based bilingual review before choosing a model.
vocabulary: Built-in versioned product terms plus automatic meeting participant/title hints. No site-specific or host-entered manual glossary. No hints were supplied in these candidate experiments.

privacy.audio: Previously authorized recording; identical frozen seven-window manifest from the matched diagnosis. Five deterministic positions plus two opening diagnostics selected after observing bad earlier output.

source_recognition.limitation: Some English is written phonetically in Devanagari; neither source fidelity nor the Original Transcript script policy is accepted.

protocol.text_candidates: Identical seven unverified ASR texts and five independent written controls. HY additionally received two new controls frozen before its outputs. Earlier five controls became diagnostic, not held-out, after the Qwen failure. No prompt tuning.
protocol.review: Agent-assisted semantic inspection of written controls, not a human bilingual audit. Literal keyword checks alone initially missed the correction reversal and are not a quality gate.
protocol.performance_limit: Sequential small samples alongside sampled healthy production, not a capacity or loaded coexistence claim.
setup_failures: HY first setup failed because a Transformers BatchEncoding was treated as a tensor; fixed input mapping and retried. No quality result was inferred from that failure.
protocol.control_review_correction: Later review identified the colloquial count clause in heldout-speaker-count as ambiguous: five approved, fifty did not can be read differently from not fifty approved. Preserve the outputs and intended expectation, but do not use this count interpretation alone as a conclusive semantic failure. Actor negation and later user-checked real failures are separate evidence.

candidates.reason: Critical reversal of a spoken correction in an independent written control.

Correction control improved; the count wording is ambiguous and not a conclusive failure by itself. Later user-checked source/English comparison exposes real question/date fidelity failures in transcription-checked-mixed-reference-validation.json.
candidates.prompt_template:
Translate the following segment into English, without additional explanation.

{source_text}
candidates.decoding: greedy, repetition_penalty=1.05, max_new_tokens=384, batch=1; official prompt, not the model card sampling recipe
candidates.runtime_warning: Transformers 5.19 reported unrecognized rope_parameters keys. This configuration is not established equivalent to the author-recommended Transformers 4.56 setup.

candidates.reason: Several drafts are much shorter than source-recognition drafts, raising an unverified coverage concern. No checked audio reference.
candidates.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=400, batch=1; no cross-window context; diagnostic confidence thresholds disabled

implementation_followup: Publish Original and English artifacts normally together, with explicit exhausted-retry fallback.
Respect independent artifact deletion fences and shared metadata retention.
Share built-in vocabulary and automatic room hints without a manual glossary store.
Separate recognition/rendering observability and final-outcome audio cleanup.
next_acceptance: Independently listen-check representative Hindi-English source and English meanings, including critical values, corrections, uncertainty and coverage. Written controls do not establish real meeting accuracy.

independent_listening_review.status: First English reference received and evaluated provisionally; three windows remain unchecked. Hindi-English reference remains needed.
independent_listening_review.selection: New 20-second windows at floor(duration × 10/35/65/85 percent), chosen without model outputs. Four windows total; first sample sufficient to start. Do not infer linguistic representativeness before human review.
independent_listening_review.reference_contract: Write source wording or faithful English meaning before viewing candidate drafts. Leave unclear speech marked; silence and unreviewable audio are valid dispositions. An English meaning reference permits semantic review, not source-language WER. Confirm source-language text and script policy separately before scoring recognition.
independent_listening_review.gate: No critical errors in checked samples; minor errors reported separately. A few windows do not establish representative production quality or speaker attribution from a mixed recording.
